full_judgment: Mustafa Kamal J: The plaintiff-respondent''s suit for eviction of the defendant-petitioner as tenant, SCC Suit No.10 of 1993, was decreed by the 1st Court of Subordinate Judge, Chittagong by judgment and order dated 17-9-94. On an application under section 25 of the Small Causes Courts Act, Civil Revision No. 3456 of 1994, a learned Single Bench of the High Court Division by judgment and order dated 21-10-97 discharged the Rule and affirmed the judgment and decree of the trial Court.
